title: Rainbow Mc
description: mod add some rainbow for minecraft.
body:
# **The most 🌈rainbow🌈 mod!**

**Made for all 🌈rainbow🌈 lovers. Now you can turn your entire Minecraft UI into a 🌈rainbow🌈.**

Enjoy the 🌈rainbow🌈 everywhere! In every menu in the game!
> - **🌈Hotbar🌈**
> - **🌈Buttons🌈**
> - **🌈Sliders🌈**
> - **🌈Glint🌈**
> - **🌈Chat🌈**

**All these elements are now 🌈rainbow🌈!**

![Rainbow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a6f923b5b50ce6ffecce9c26950bc4d2a2ee413c_0.webp)

**You can enjoy the 🌈rainbow🌈 while chatting with friends, adjusting game settings, checking your hotbar, or even just in the main menu!**

_Also mod fixes entity rendering in the inventory._

_Checked and approved by **🌈Rainbow Dash🌈**!_
